source_definition_basis: The researcher supplied the platform service wording in direct answer to the question about these two 30-record tasks. It explicitly describes AI samples answering the questionnaire for preliminary research/pretesting. This resolves the prior ambiguous general human-recruitment description.
independently_read_in_authenticated_UI: The two task notices, their counts, source labels and AI-point records were inspected. The explanatory wording itself was provided by the researcher, not freshly read from an identified web page.
service_definition_original: 这个是基于问卷星对问卷调研行业的深入了解，我们会基于您当前问卷项目和社会人群现实，让AI匹配一批契合社会现实的样本，并让这些AI样本来作答您的问卷。AI样本适合项目前期的预研究、预测试，每个问卷最多可通过AI样本回收100份答卷。

synthetic_records.selector: original 来源 contains AI样本
synthetic_records.role: AI-produced pretest responses; excluded from human-preference estimation

primary_records.role: human-recruitment analytic records based on ordinary submission metadata and researcher recruitment report
primary_records.quality_scope: Not a certification of demographic representativeness, eligibility or every individual response; retain the early-record sensitivity

mixed_records.role: mixed human/AI diagnostic and explicitly labelled computational stress analysis only; never 360 human respondents

actual_version_allocation: Different recruitment channels each administered one version; no allocation log. No causal version comparison.
AI_model_prompt_persona_selection_and_de: Not available; no specific underlying LLM or general AI-generator performance is inferred.
previous_general_human_recruitment_repor: Superseded for these 60 task-linked records by the supplied explicit AI-pretest wording.
